cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 77 since November 2018. Former cosmetology instructor, floor manager and program director, and later a nonprofit director. Holds a master's in leadership management and a Ph.D. in criminal justice and safety studies.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as recommended in two 2026 voter guides: "SPEAK, SOUTH: Watchu Really Want?" (Sway voting group by Destiny) and "Tabitha's List: Candidates You Can Trust" (Sway voting group by Tabitha Isner).

cands.gaps: We couldn't find where TaShina Morris was born or raised, or when she came to Alabama. We found no statements from her on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. We also found no bills she sponsored or other actions on those topics. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. The pages we read give no documented position from her on data centers or development. They show no controversies and no foreign ties, though that does not mean none exist. Her sponsored-bill list on Ballotpedia did not load, so we can't say which bills she carried.

qual.background: Alabama House member for District 77 since November 2018, re-elected in 2022 and 2026. Earlier she worked as a cosmetology instructor and floor manager, a program director at a cosmetology school, and a nonprofit director.
qual.why: Seven-plus years of legislative service in the chamber places her in the high band. Her work as a program and nonprofit director adds management experience. Committee seats and the committee vice-chair post were not counted.
